detail: Amalgamations Private Limited has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to NSE. This filing is mandatory when an acquirer crosses a 25% shareholding threshold or acquires control of a listed entity. The disclosure triggers mandatory public announcement and, depending on the exact quantum and circumstances, may necessitate an open offer to minority shareholders. The transaction is in the tea/agro-processing sector, a traditional Indian commodity business.
